paper.title_en: X-ray Reflection as Diagnostic of Supermassive Black Hole Binary Properties
paper.abstract_en: We investigate correlations between prominent features in the relativistic X-ray reflection spectrum emitted by an accreting supermassive black hole (SMBH) binary with the underlying properties of the binary system. Model-independent measurements of the relativistic Fe K$α$ line ($\sim$6.4 keV) and the Compton reflection hump ($\sim$20-30 keV) are shown to be useful in constraining binary parameters. We compute 24,570 X-ray reflection spectra from two mini-disks attached to SMBHs at a fixed separation of 100 $GM/c^2$ on circular orbits, by varying its mass ratio, spin parameters, inclination, orbital phase and total mass accretion rate. We find that the location of the blue peak in the relativistic Fe K$α$ is a relatively robust diagnostic of the binary inclination, which could be obtained from a single-epoch X-ray spectrum. Given a few epochs of spectra, one may be able to determine the orbital phase of the binary and place constraints on its mass ratio by monitoring the Fe K$α$ centroid. Of all parameters, SMBH spin effects are most subtle and prone to measurement degeneracies. Some markers of high SMBH spin may nevertheless surface in the composite spectrum due to increased radiative efficiency. The approach developed here can be used to place preliminary constraints on binary parameters before a full parametrized X-ray spectral fitting method is available. It complements gravitational wave measurements by the Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) and the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna by providing independent constraints on binary parameters that may be prone to degeneracy (inclination), or otherwise inaccessible (spin for PTAs).

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文利用相对论X射线反射光谱（Fe Kα线蓝峰与Compton反射鼓包）作为超大质量双黑洞参数的诊断工具，构建了24,570个反射谱的网格，并明确讨论了其与脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）及LISA引力波测量的互补性，包括倾角简并和PTA无法获取自旋等问题。主题与PTA及超大质量双黑洞相关，方法系统、物理内容较深，摘要清晰，值得点开进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: X射线反射作为超大质量黑洞双星性质的诊断工具
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了吸积超大质量黑洞（SMBH）双星所发射的相对论X射线反射光谱中显著特征与该双星系统底层性质之间的相关性。对相对论Fe K$\alpha$线（$\sim$6.4 keV）和Compton反射鼓包（$\sim$20-30 keV）的模型无关测量被证明可用于约束双星参数。我们针对附着于SMBH的两个小吸积盘、在固定间距100 $GM/c^2$的圆轨道上计算了24,570个X射线反射谱，并改变其质量比、自旋参数、倾角、轨道相位和总吸积率。我们发现，相对论Fe K$\alpha$中蓝峰的位置是双星倾角一个相对稳健的诊断量，可从单历元X射线光谱中获得。若给定若干历元的谱，人们或许能够确定双星的轨道相位，并通过监测Fe K$\alpha$质心对其质量比施加约束。在所有参数中，SMBH自旋效应最为细微，且易出现测量简并。尽管如此，高SMBH自旋的一些标志仍可能由于辐射效率提高而出现在复合光谱中。本文所发展的方法可用于在完整的参数化X射线光谱拟合方法可用之前，对双星参数施加初步约束。它补充了脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的引力波测量，方法是对可能易受简并影响的（倾角）或原本无法获取的（PTA情形下的自旋）双星参数提供独立约束。
